description: Source code for 'iwcap.c', a radiotap capture utility that outputs pcap dumps, handling raw socket capture, filtering, and ring buffer management.

methods.name: check_type
methods.description: Checks if the network interface supports radiotap by verifying hardware address family.

methods.name: set_promisc
methods.description: Enables or disables promiscuous mode on the network interface.

methods.name: sig_dump
methods.description: Signal handler to trigger dumping ring buffer contents.

methods.name: write_pcap_header
methods.description: Writes pcap global header to output file.

methods.name: write_pcap_frame
methods.description: Writes individual pcap frame header and data.

methods.name: ringbuf_init
methods.description: Initializes ring buffer for packet storage.

methods.name: ringbuf_add
methods.description: Adds a new entry to the ring buffer with timestamp.

methods.name: ringbuf_get
methods.description: Retrieves a ring buffer entry at a specific index.
